we have developed a new approach for spatial reconstruction and computational modeling of structures involved in the signaling cascade that couples excitation and contraction in cardiac myocytes.

The main takeaway from our work is that

3D imaging of fixed and permeablized myocytes, followed by appropriate digital image processing, can lead to spatial reconstructions of myocyte structures and proteins suitable for computational modeling.
confocal microscopy and digital image processing can be used to reconstruct 3D structures of myocytes and other cells.
the approach can be used to reconstruct 3D structures of interest for computational models of EC coupling in cardiac myocytes.
